D-001.rationale: R01 only guarantees inventory-number uniqueness within each fund, so the R02 URL derived exclusively from that number cannot be globally unique. The address scheme or identifier constraint must change.

D-002.rationale: R03 permits public display only of approved images, while R04 bulk-publishes every format-valid image without checking rights. Requiring a consistent rights decision in bulk publication resolves the contradiction.

D-003.rationale: R10 requires conversion from mixed centimetre/millimetre data with no unit metadata or fund-unit mapping. Identifying the source unit for each row enables the correct conversion.

D-004.rationale: R12 forbids point updates or live status checks between daily index exports, which cannot reliably satisfy the R13 ten-minute removal deadline. Index update or filtering behavior must change.

D-005.rationale: R07 gives subjective natural-colour/no-noticeable-distortion expectations without comparison method or measurable acceptance criteria. Establishing the method and criterion makes the requirement verifiable.

D-006.rationale: R08 does not say how to compare a precise date against a century or interval where the represented periods overlap. A common sort key/order rule makes the required chronology determinate.
